name: send_message
description: Sends a message to another agent on the team. The message is queued and delivered at the start of the recipient's next turn. Use it to ask for information, coordinate work, or report results to a colleague. The sender is recorded automatically.

target.description: Name of the recipient as it appears in the run's member list, or the role they hold. The @ prefix is optional.

message.description: The message content for the colleague (max 1000 characters).
